conflicts.description: The meeting recording says some pharma customer contracts restrict data transfers outside the EU, while the company overview says several customer contracts, especially in pharma, restrict transfers outside the EU/EEA. The sources describe different geographic boundaries for the restrictions, and the instructions provide no hierarchy to resolve the difference.
